propositions: The deployed MCP server container lacks the pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock] extra in Dockerfile.mcp, causing LLMConfigError when review_plan attempts to initialize the configured Bedrock provider.

The review_plan call degrades to INDETERMINATE with llm_unavailable=true and returns an unsigned verdict because the Bedrock provider cannot be imported, preventing plan-review attestation from being minted.
The MCP container has no AWS region configured (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION are unset), causing NoRegionError when boto3.session attempts bedrock-runtime construction.

The repo .venv includes boto3 via [dev] dependencies and masks this defect locally, while the composed container lacks both [dev] and [bedrock] extras, creating a divergence between local CLI behavior (works) and deployed MCP server (fails).
